name: Kaleidoscope Bus Shelter
description: A desert bus shelter made of kaleidoscope glass and mirrors casts intricate rainbow patterns across the sand.
prompt: A single striking image of a small desert bus shelter built from kaleidoscope glass panels and mirrored steel. Sunlight passes through, casting intricate rainbow patterns across the sand and a lone traveler resting inside. Cacti and distant mesas, clear blue sky, modern surreal architecture, crisp shadows, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Waiting for the bus has never looked this colorful. Would you sit inside a kaleidoscope?
